name: tiles-onpolicy
stage: offline gate, then an e2e screen (both predeclared here, before re-encoding or training)

data.same_as: value-v2-tiles (roots value-tiles-v1, point end_turn, stride 3, split train 3100000+95000 / test 3195000+5000)
data.reference_test: runs/value-v2-100k-shards test split (2745000+5000; planner_offer_accept self-play), scored for non-inferiority

common.augment: one of the 12 hex symmetries per row per batch (encoder-v2 permutation applied before any structuring)
common.epoch_selection: lowest validation BCE of P(I win) on the last 5,000 train games; never test

arms.tiles: tile-token transformer: 19 tile tokens (tile features + its 6 corners' vertex features + its 6 sides' edge features, Settlers-RL style), 4 player tokens (seat-relative), 1 global token; learned type/position embeddings; 4 pre-norm encoder layers, d 128, 4 heads, MLP 256, dropout .1; P(I win) from the global token

gate.primary: arm 'tiles' trained on the on-policy data (common settings unchanged: architecture, AdamW 7e-4, wd .05, cosine 3% warmup, 12 epochs, batch 4096, 12-symmetry augmentation, seed 0, epoch selection on the last 5,000 train games) vs the served reference runs/arch-bakeoff-v1/tiles.pt (pt fb239324…), judged on: (1) the on-policy test rows (3195000+5000): AUC(new) - AUC(ref) >= 0 with game-clustered bootstrap 95% LCB > -0.002 (1,000 resamples, seed 29); (2) the original test rows (2745000+5000): non-inferior, AUC(new) - AUC(ref) game-clustered LCB > -0.005; (3) within-decision cross-eval on runs/pv2-test-v2 (scripts/cross_eval_arch.py, both receipts bound as in tiles-tta-ens): new pick - served >= ref pick - served - 0.002, new receipt eligible. All three must hold; anything missing is not a pass.
gate.reported: test AUC, log loss, ECE10 on both test sets; cross-eval with city-vs-end ranking; truncated games dropped (count)

note: Board #1 T3 (Jerry 2026-11-09: 'Let's execute on the transformer improvements'; owner decision to bundle the purchase fixes). Predeclared 2026-11-09 before re-encoding, training or any test read. Weights stay local; only metadata is committed.

screen.candidate: planner_pv2_tiles with the new on-policy weights AND the red-team purchase-scoring fixes (D1/D3/D4, PR #59), bundled per the owner's decision (board #1 comment 6756308802)
screen.tables: tactical / mixed / self as in exact-screen
screen.gate: +.02 paired lift on every table, 0 truncations, p95 decision <= 2 s, step max <= 5 s, turn max <= 20 s
screen.power: alternative +.04, sigma .22, power .8 (check_design admitted 260 for this design)
screen.attribution: a bundled candidate: a pass supports the bundle, not either change alone
